questions.sentence: Shubho Bijoya!
options: Shubho Bijoya, bhalo thakben.
Shubho noboborsho, bhai.
Shubho jonmodin, tomake.
questions.correctAnswer: Shubho Bijoya, bhalo thakben.
questions.translatedSentence: Happy Bijoya, take care.

questions.sentence: Shubho noboborsho!
options: Happy new year!
Happy birthday to you!
Happy Bijoya to you!
questions.correctAnswer: Happy new year!

questions.sentence: Pujo kemon katche?
options: Khub bhalo katche, dhonyobad.
Ami ekhon bhaat khachchi.
Amar bari Kolkatay.
questions.correctAnswer: Khub bhalo katche, dhonyobad.
questions.translatedSentence: It is going very well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Ajke pujor prothom din.
options: Today is the first day of the Pujo.
Today is the last day of the Pujo.
Today is a holiday for us.
questions.correctAnswer: Today is the first day of the Pujo.

questions.sentence: Tomake onek shubhechha.
options: Tomakeo onek shubhechha.
Tomake dhonyobad, ami ekhon jachchi.
Ami ekhon bari te achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Tomakeo onek shubhechha.
questions.translatedSentence: Many good wishes to you too.

questions.sentence: Amader bari te aj utsav.
options: There is a celebration at our house today.
There is a celebration at our house tomorrow.
We are going out of the house today.
questions.correctAnswer: There is a celebration at our house today.

questions.sentence: Shubho Saraswati Pujo!
options: Tomakeo shubho Saraswati Pujo!
Tomakeo shubho noboborsho!
Tomakeo shubho Bijoya!
questions.correctAnswer: Tomakeo shubho Saraswati Pujo!
questions.translatedSentence: Happy Saraswati Puja to you too!

questions.sentence: Ami pujo khub bhalobashi.
options: I love the Pujo very much.
I like sweets very much.
I go to the Pujo every day.
questions.correctAnswer: I love the Pujo very much.

questions.sentence: Ei mishti ta nao, pujor mishti.
options: Dhonyobad, khub bhalo lagche.
Na, ami cha khai na.
Ami bajare mach kinte jachchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhonyobad, khub bhalo lagche.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, it tastes really good.

questions.sentence: Durga Pujo kobe hoy?
options: Shorot kale hoy, October mashe.
Boshonto kale hoy, February mashe.
Gorom kale hoy, June mashe.
questions.correctAnswer: Shorot kale hoy, October mashe.
questions.translatedSentence: It falls in autumn, in the month of October.

questions.sentence: Poila Boishakh Bangla bochorer prothom din.
options: Poila Boishakh is the first day of the Bengali year.
Poila Boishakh is the last day of the Bengali year.
Poila Boishakh is a holiday in every Bengali house.
questions.correctAnswer: Poila Boishakh is the first day of the Bengali year.

questions.sentence: Saraswati Pujo kon somoy hoy?
options: Boshonto kale hoy, Magh mashe.
Shorot kale hoy, Ashwin mashe.
Sheet kale hoy, Poush mashe.
questions.correctAnswer: Boshonto kale hoy, Magh mashe.
questions.translatedSentence: It falls in spring, in the month of Magh.

questions.sentence: Kali Pujo Durga Pujor kichu din pore ashe.
options: Kali Puja comes a few days after Durga Puja.
Kali Puja comes a few days before Durga Puja.
Kali Puja and Durga Puja fall on the same day.
questions.correctAnswer: Kali Puja comes a few days after Durga Puja.

questions.sentence: Durga Pujo koto din dhore choley?
options: Panch din dhore choley, Shashthi theke Doshomi.
Sara mash dhore choley, Ashwin mashe.
Ek din e sesh hoye jay, sokal theke rat.
questions.correctAnswer: Panch din dhore choley, Shashthi theke Doshomi.
questions.translatedSentence: It runs for five days, from Shashthi to Doshomi.

questions.sentence: Kali Pujor rate sob ghore alo jole.
options: On the night of Kali Puja lights burn in every house.
On the night of Kali Puja we sing in every house.
On the morning of Kali Puja we clean the whole house.
questions.correctAnswer: On the night of Kali Puja lights burn in every house.

questions.sentence: Aar koto din pore pujo?
options: Aar mattro dosh din baki ache.
Pujo gato mashe sesh hoye geche.
Ami pujor somoy Kolkatay thaki.
questions.correctAnswer: Aar mattro dosh din baki ache.
questions.translatedSentence: Only ten more days are left.

questions.sentence: Amar pujor chhuti Shashthir din theke shuru hoy.
options: My Pujo holidays start from the day of Shashthi.
My Pujo holidays end on the day of Shashthi.
My Pujo holidays are only five days long.
questions.correctAnswer: My Pujo holidays start from the day of Shashthi.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki proti bochor Kolkatay pujo dekho?
options: Ha, ami proti bochor pujo dekhte Kolkatay ashi.
Ha, ami roj sokale cha banai.
Na, amar Kolkata bhalo lage na kichu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ami proti bochor pujo dekhte Kolkatay ashi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I come to Kolkata every year to see the Pujo.

questions.sentence: Amader barite pujor din khete asben.
options: Nishchoi asbo, onek dhonyobad.
Na, ami ranna korte pari na.
Ami ekhon barir bhitore achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Nishchoi asbo, onek dhonyobad.
questions.translatedSentence: I will certainly come, thank you very much.

questions.sentence: Ami tomake amader pujor nimontron korchi.
options: I am inviting you to our Pujo.
I am going to their Pujo with you.
I have already invited them to our Pujo.
questions.correctAnswer: I am inviting you to our Pujo.

questions.sentence: Apnara kokhon asben, sokale na bikele?
options: Amra bikele asbo, char tar por.
Amra kalke bajar jachchi.
Amra Howrah bridger kachhe thaki.
questions.correctAnswer: Amra bikele asbo, char tar por.
questions.translatedSentence: We will come in the evening, after four.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki amar songe pandal dekhte jabe?
options: Will you go with me to see the pandals?
Did you go to see the pandals with them?
Shall I go to see the pandals alone?
questions.correctAnswer: Will you go with me to see the pandals?

questions.sentence: Dukkhito, ami ashte parbo na, amar kaj ache.
options: Kono osubidha nei, porer bar eso.
Tahole ami tomar jonyo opekkha korbo.
Thik ache, ami ekhoni pouche jachchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kono osubidha nei, porer bar eso.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem at all, come next time.

questions.sentence: Jodi somoy pao, tahole sondhye belay chole eso.
options: If you get the time, come over in the evening.
If you have no time, do not come in the evening.
When you get the time, call me in the evening.
questions.correctAnswer: If you get the time, come over in the evening.

questions.sentence: Tomar poribar ke o niye eso.
options: Obosshoi, ami sobaike niye asbo.
Obosshoi, ami tomar jonyo mishti anbo.
Obosshoi, ami taratari bari fire jabo.
questions.correctAnswer: Obosshoi, ami sobaike niye asbo.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, I will bring everyone along.

questions.sentence: Apnar nimontron peye khub bhalo laglo.
options: I was very glad to receive your invitation.
I was very glad to send you an invitation.
I am still waiting for your invitation.
questions.correctAnswer: I was very glad to receive your invitation.

questions.sentence: Ashte ektu deri hoye gelo, kichu mone korben na.
options: Are na na, apni eshechen ei to onek.
Thik ache, ami tahole chole jachchi.
Tahole apni kal bikele asben.
questions.correctAnswer: Are na na, apni eshechen ei to onek.
questions.translatedSentence: Not at all, it is more than enough that you came.

questions.sentence: Pujo te tomar priyo mishti ki?
options: Amar sob theke priyo mishti roshogolla.
Amar sob theke priyo khabar macher jhol.
Amar sob theke priyo utsav Durga Pujo.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar sob theke priyo mishti roshogolla.
questions.translatedSentence: My favourite sweet of all is roshogolla.

questions.sentence: Ma aj sokale narkel nadu banachchen.
options: Mother is making coconut sweets this morning.
Mother made coconut sweets yesterday morning.
Mother will buy coconut sweets this morning.
questions.correctAnswer: Mother is making coconut sweets this morning.

questions.sentence: Ashtomir dupure apnara ki khaben?
options: Amra pandale khichuri bhog khabo.
Amra sokale luchi kheye niyechi.
Amra rate baire khete jachchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Amra pandale khichuri bhog khabo.
questions.translatedSentence: We will eat the khichuri bhog at the pandal.

questions.sentence: Bijoyar din amra sobai mishti mukh kori.
options: On the day of Bijoya we all share sweets.
On the day of Bijoya we all cook together.
On the day of Bijoya we all go out together.
questions.correctAnswer: On the day of Bijoya we all share sweets.

questions.sentence: Aro ekta sondesh nao na, khub bhalo hoyeche.
options: Na bhai, ami onek kheye felechi.
Ha, ami mishti banate bhalobashi.
Na, amar cha e cheeni lagbe na.
questions.correctAnswer: Na bhai, ami onek kheye felechi.
questions.translatedSentence: No my friend, I have already eaten a lot.

questions.sentence: Poila Boishakhe amra barite luchi ar alur dom banai.
options: On Poila Boishakh we make luchi and potato curry at home.
On Poila Boishakh we eat luchi and potato curry outside.
On Poila Boishakh we take luchi and potato curry to the pandal.
questions.correctAnswer: On Poila Boishakh we make luchi and potato curry at home.

questions.sentence: Payesh ta kemon holo?
options: Osadharon hoyeche, aro ektu debe?
Ekhono ranna hoyni, ektu opekkha koro.
Ami payesher jonyo dudh niye eshechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Osadharon hoyeche, aro ektu debe?
questions.translatedSentence: It turned out wonderful, will you give me a little more?

questions.sentence: Bhog khete hole sokal sokal pandale ashte hobe.
options: If you want the bhog you have to reach the pandal early.
If you want the bhog you have to cook at the pandal.
If you reach the pandal early you can sit in front.
questions.correctAnswer: If you want the bhog you have to reach the pandal early.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki pujor kodin niramish khaccho?
options: Ha, Ashtomir din ami mach mangsho khai na.
Ha, ami roj sokale ek cup cha khai.
Na, ami ekhon ranna ghore kaj korchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, Ashtomir din ami mach mangsho khai na.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, on Ashtami I do not eat fish or meat.

questions.sentence: Ei pujoy koyta notun jama kinle?
options: Ei bar tinte notun jama kinechi.
Ei bar amra pandale gechilam.
Ei bar mishti khub dami hoye geche.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei bar tinte notun jama kinechi.
questions.translatedSentence: This time I have bought three new outfits.

questions.sentence: Baba amake pujoy ekta notun panjabi diyechen.
options: Father gave me a new panjabi for the Pujo.
Father bought himself a new panjabi for the Pujo.
I gave father a new panjabi for the Pujo.
questions.correctAnswer: Father gave me a new panjabi for the Pujo.

questions.sentence: Ei sharee ta tomar jonyo enechi.
options: Eto sundor, tomake onek dhonyobad!
Ami sharee ta kal dokane dekhechilam.
Amar didi sharee porte bhalobashe.
questions.correctAnswer: Eto sundor, tomake onek dhonyobad!
questions.translatedSentence: It is so beautiful, thank you so much!

questions.sentence: Pujor somoy sob attiyo amader barite ashe.
options: At Pujo time all our relatives come to our house.
At Pujo time we go to all our relatives houses.
At Pujo time our relatives stay in their own houses.
questions.correctAnswer: At Pujo time all our relatives come to our house.

questions.sentence: Tomar didi ki ei bar bari asche?
options: Ha, didi Doshomir age chole asbe.
Ha, ami kal didir barite jachchi.
Didi amake ekta notun jama diyeche.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, didi Doshomir age chole asbe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, my elder sister will come home before Doshomi.

questions.sentence: Boroder pranam korle tara ashirbad koren.
options: When you touch the elders feet, they give you their blessing.
When the elders bless you, you must thank them.
The elders touch our feet and give us gifts.
questions.correctAnswer: When you touch the elders feet, they give you their blessing.

questions.sentence: Bijoyar din tumi ki koro?
options: Amra boroder pranam kori ar mishti khai.
Amra sokal sokal bajare mach kinte jai.
Amra sara rat pandale gan shuni.
questions.correctAnswer: Amra boroder pranam kori ar mishti khai.
questions.translatedSentence: We touch the elders feet and eat sweets.

questions.sentence: Ei upohar ta chotoder jonyo, kintu ekhon kholo na.
options: This gift is for the children, but do not open it now.
This gift is from the children, so open it now.
This gift is for the children, but it is not ready now.
questions.correctAnswer: This gift is for the children, but do not open it now.

questions.sentence: Ei bochor sobai ek songe ekta chobi tulbo to?
options: Nishchoi, sobai ek songe daran, ami tulchi.
Ha, ami tomar jonyo onek mishti enechi.
Ha, amra kal bikele pandale gechilam.
questions.correctAnswer: Nishchoi, sobai ek songe daran, ami tulchi.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, everyone stand together and I will take it.

questions.sentence: Apnar meyer biye kobe thik holo?
options: Agami Ogrohayon mashe, jodi sob thik thake.
Amra kal ekta biye barite khete gechilam.
Ami biye te ei notun sharee ta porechilam.
questions.correctAnswer: Agami Ogrohayon mashe, jodi sob thik thake.
questions.translatedSentence: Next Ogrohayon, if everything goes to plan.

questions.sentence: Ami biye te jete parini, karon amar sorir kharap chilo.
options: I could not go to the wedding because I was unwell.
I did not go to the wedding because nobody invited me.
I went to the wedding even though I was unwell.
questions.correctAnswer: I could not go to the wedding because I was unwell.

questions.sentence: Jamai Shoshthi te apnara ki koren?
options: Amra jamaike nimontron kore bhalo mondo ranna kori.
Amra Ashtomir sokale pandale anjali dii.
Amra noboborshe dokane hal khata kori.
questions.correctAnswer: Amra jamaike nimontron kore bhalo mondo ranna kori.
questions.translatedSentence: We invite our son-in-law over and cook him a big meal.

questions.sentence: Jodi apnar somoy hoy, tahole biyer age ekbar amader barite asben.
options: If you have the time, please come to our house once before the wedding.
If you have the time, please come to our house once after the wedding.
Since you have the time, come to our house on the wedding day itself.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have the time, please come to our house once before the wedding.

questions.sentence: Biye barite eto lok, apni kauke chinte parchen?
options: Kichu lok ke chini, tobe beshir bhag ke chini na.
Ami ei barite age kokhono ashini.
Ami amar bondhu derke o nimontron korechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kichu lok ke chini, tobe beshir bhag ke chini na.
questions.translatedSentence: I know a few people, but most of them I do not know.

questions.sentence: Bou bhat er din amra sobai notun jama porechilam.
options: On the day of the reception we all wore new clothes.
On the day of the reception we all ate together.
Before the reception we all bought new clothes.
questions.correctAnswer: On the day of the reception we all wore new clothes.

questions.sentence: Apnara ki noboborshe dokane hal khata koren?
options: Ha, protyek bochor kori, ar sobaike mishti khaoai.
Na, amra Kali Pujor rate dokan bondho rakhi.
Ha, amra sokal sokal dokan khule boshi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, protyek bochor kori, ar sobaike mishti khaoai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we do it every year, and we give everyone sweets.

questions.sentence: Biyer nimontron peyechi, kintu jete parbo kina jani na.
options: I have got the wedding invitation, but I do not know if I can go.
I have got the wedding invitation, so I will surely go.
I did not get the wedding invitation, so I am not going.
questions.correctAnswer: I have got the wedding invitation, but I do not know if I can go.

questions.sentence: Onushthan ta kemon laglo apnar?
options: Khub sundor hoyeche, tobe ektu beshi bhir chilo.
Ha, ami apnake age i nimontron kore diyechi.
Amra tram e kore sokal sokal chole eshechilam.
questions.correctAnswer: Khub sundor hoyeche, tobe ektu beshi bhir chilo.
questions.translatedSentence: It was lovely, though the crowd was a bit too much.
